name: DTT: Defend the Tree
summary: DTT: Defend The Tree is a mobile defense race game by Loend that combines tower defense with time-attack competition. Players charge through waves of the Grima alongside a Treant, throwing skill cards at the right moment to break enemy lines and rescue the Anima. Players build a party of Anima guardians and runes, pick augments and relics during each run, and face chapter bosses with distinct attack patterns. Every stage records the clear time, and players compete in rankings for the fastest clear.
